items.title: Primary estimand fully defined
items.requirement: The primary estimand states all five attributes: treatment condition(s) compared, population, variable (endpoint), handling of intercurrent events, and population-level summary measure.
items.query: estimand attributes treatment population variable intercurrent events population-level summary

items.title: Intercurrent events identified
items.requirement: Anticipated intercurrent events are listed (e.g. treatment discontinuation, rescue or additional medication, treatment switching, death, lens dispensing changes).
items.query: intercurrent events examples discontinuation of treatment rescue medication

items.title: Strategy per intercurrent event
items.requirement: A strategy is specified and justified for each intercurrent event (treatment policy, hypothetical, composite variable, while on treatment, principal stratum).
items.query: strategies for addressing intercurrent events treatment policy hypothetical composite while on treatment principal stratum

items.title: Main estimator aligned and pre-specified
items.requirement: The main estimator (model, covariates, handling of data) is aligned with the estimand and specified unambiguously.
items.query: main estimator aligned with estimand pre-specified unambiguously

items.title: Missing data distinguished from intercurrent events
items.requirement: Missing data are defined relative to the estimand, assumptions are stated (e.g. MAR) and the handling method is consistent with the estimand.
items.query: missing data assumptions handling estimator intercurrent events distinction

items.title: Sensitivity analysis
items.requirement: Sensitivity analyses target the same estimand and vary the main estimator's assumptions in a structured way (e.g. MNAR / tipping point).
items.query: sensitivity analysis same estimand assumptions robustness structured approach

items.title: Supplementary analyses
items.requirement: Supplementary analyses (targeting different estimands or estimators) are identified and distinguished from sensitivity analyses.
items.query: supplementary analysis distinguished from sensitivity analysis

items.title: Secondary estimands
items.requirement: Estimands are also defined for key secondary objectives likely to support regulatory decisions.
items.query: estimands for secondary trial objectives documenting estimands protocol

items.title: Design and conduct support the estimand
items.requirement: Data collection plans support the estimand (e.g. continued follow-up after discontinuation under treatment policy).
items.query: trial design conduct data collection after discontinuation estimand

items.title: Sample size reflects the estimand
items.requirement: Sample size assumptions reflect the estimand (e.g. expected intercurrent event rates and their effect on the treatment effect or variability).
items.query: sample size estimand intercurrent events planning
